edges.reason: Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, establishing the initial privileged owner.
Constructor reads msg.sender to initialize owner.
auth modifier requires isAuthorized(msg.sender, msg.sig) before setOwner executes.
auth modifier requires isAuthorized(msg.sender, msg.sig) before setAuthority executes.
setOwner writes the privileged owner state variable.
setAuthority writes the authority state variable.
isAuthorized reads owner to compare against src.
isAuthorized reads authority and delegates canCall.
setAdminByOwner requires msg.sender == owner.
setAdminByAdmin requires msg.sender == admin.
setOwnerByAdmin requires msg.sender == admin.
kill onlyOwner checks owner == msg.sender.
withdrawStuckFunds onlyOwner checks owner == msg.sender.
kill invokes selfdestruct to destroy the contract.
upgrade makes an external call to an attacker-controlled contract that re-enters setCompleted.
deposit requires msg.sender == _user before operating on solo margin.
withdraw requires msg.sender == _user before operating on solo margin.
deposit builds actions against the soloMargin instance.
withdraw builds actions against the soloMargin instance.
getFee uses tx.origin in BotRegistry.botList to choose the fee tier.
getFee transfers ETH/tokens to WALLET_ADDR, an external value transfer before returning.
deposit performs external token transfers, approval and lending pool deposit before returning.
withdraw redeems aTokens then transfers underlying to msg.sender via withdrawTokens.
borrow calls lending pool then transfers borrowed funds to msg.sender.
deposit performs external transfers/mint calls to cToken market.
withdraw redeems cTokens then transfers underlying to msg.sender.
callProxy reads and writes nonces to prevent replay, then executes on the proxy.
callProxy requires the recovered signer to be msg.sender-independent user and proxy owner check.
changeMonitor stores now (block.timestamp) into changeRequestedTimestamp.
confirmNewMonitor checks (changeRequestedTimestamp + CHANGE_PERIOD) < now.
MCDMonitorProxyV2.changeMonitor records now as changeRequestedTimestamp.
confirmNewMonitor uses now to compare against the change period.
AaveMonitorProxy.changeMonitor records now as changeRequestedTimestamp.
confirmNewMonitor uses now to compare against the change period.
givePermission reads the current authority into currAuthority.
givePermission assigns or creates the DSGuard used to permit execution.
givePermission is the counterpart of removePermission for proxy authorization.
getFee initializes local fee from service fee constants.
getFee computes and stores the returned feeAmount.
setOwner consumes the owner_ parameter.
setAuthority consumes the authority_ parameter.
setAdminByOwner consumes the _admin parameter.
setOwnerByAdmin consumes the _owner parameter.
changeMonitor consumes the _newMonitor parameter.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter owner_ is directly used by DSAuth.setOwner to write the owner state variable.
Parameter authority_ is directly used by DSAuth.setAuthority to write the authority state variable.
Parameter _admin is directly assigned to the admin state variable in setAdminByOwner.
Parameter _owner is directly assigned to the owner state variable in setOwnerByAdmin.
Parameter _amount feeds the fee computation in AaveHelper.getFee.
Parameter _user is used for custom fee lookup and wallet accounting in getFee.
Parameter _tokenAddr selects ETH vs ERC20 transfer path in getFee.
Parameter _newMonitor is stored as newMonitor by CompoundMonitorProxy.changeMonitor.
Local fee variable is only used inside AaveHelper.getFee to pick the fee divisor.
Local feeAmount variable is only used inside AaveHelper.getFee as the return value.
Local currAuthority is only used inside ProxyPermission.givePermission.
Local guard reference is only used inside ProxyPermission.givePermission.
